# Box

Box is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { Box } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Foundations
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/foundations-box--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { Box, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function BoxExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Box className="p-4 bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-control">
        This is a Box
      </Box>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## Box

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `BoxProps`, which extends `React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional, default `false`.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 263 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
